title.en: Google makes Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available
title.zhHans: 谷歌将 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 转为正式可用

searchSummary.en: Google announced general availability for Omni 1.2 Flash on November 5, with video generation and editing up to 15 seconds.
searchSummary.zhHans: 谷歌于 11 月 5 日宣布 Omni 1.2 Flash 正式可用，可生成和编辑最长 15 秒的视频。

summary.en: Google said Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash became generally available via the Gemini API and Google Cloud on November 5. The announced maximum video length is 15 seconds, compared with 10 seconds for Omni 1.1. A Google Cloud article dated November 6 repeats general availability. Neither company benchmarks nor promotional user examples establish independently measured quality or broad production adoption.
summary.zhHans: 谷歌称，Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 于 11 月 5 日通过 Gemini API 和 Google Cloud 正式可用。公告所列视频时长上限为 15 秒，Omni 1.1 为 10 秒。谷歌云于 11 月 6 日再刊文确认正式可用。厂商跑分和推广案例不能证明画质已获独立验证或大规模生产采用。

narrative.en: The November 5 launch date comes from the dated Google announcement; the November 6 cloud post is a subsequent confirmation, not a separate first launch. The 15-second limit is a product specification, not a measured external outcome.
narrative.zhHans: 11 月 5 日依据谷歌带日期的公告；11 月 6 日云平台文章是后续确认，并非另一次首次发布。15 秒是产品规格，不是外部使用成效。
